diagnosis: v4 fixed the start. In all 8 entered invoices (42-48, 50), steps 1-6 worked: click lower 'Supplier', type_supplier + Return, click date, type_date (the field shows '15/08/2026', then 'Aug 15, 2026'), click '+ Add Row'. Nothing in that part is changed.

All 8 failed at step 7. After Add Row the row's item input reads '× Item' or 'X Item' at x≈631 y≈472 (S7, S31), not 'Item'. The playbook named it "the LOWER 'Item'" and gave the Rate cell as the target after the item, so Jev clicked '$ 0.00' below 'Rate' (976,472). The item was never entered.

Clicking the Rate cell puts it in edit mode: it reads '0.00' without '$' at x≈981 (S8). Jev then clicked that '0.00' 4-7 more times with screen_changed=False (#42 steps 8-13, #43, #44, #47, #48). It never typed, because the hints say type_amount requires the item name in the row.

In #45, #46 and #50 (step 8) Jev clicked the column header 'Item' at 643,422. That click focuses nothing, so type_item did not reach the item cell and '× Item' is still in the row afterwards (S33, S41, S61). The reflex Return then scrolled the form down (S34). Jev clicked Net Total '$0.00' at 815,285 three times with no effect.
No hint covers the scrolled form in S34, where 'Number Series' and 'Supplier' are gone and 'Add Row' stands at y≈203. scroll_up is needed there.

The old x coordinates for the row (476, 1079, 1241) no longer match the layout. The real ones are '× Item' 631, Rate '$ 0.00' 976, Amount '$ 0.00' 1074. Both money cells read '$ 0.00', so only the 'below' value ('Rate' or 'Amount') tells them apart.

Read stage: both Anthropic invoices (#44, #48) again picked '$200.00 USD due <date>, 2026' and read the amount as 2026. They would fail the amount check even with perfect entry. Venice and Moonshot picked short lines like '$10.00 USD', so a short amount line presumably exists on these Stripe-style invoices.
